explanation: Mathlib's `genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y] : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y` instantiates to X = Y = Mdl.C and f = ψ (an iso, so `[IsIso ψ]` gives `IsOpenImmersion ψ` via the instance `IsOpenImmersion.of_isIso`), yielding `ψ.base (genericPoint Mdl.C) = genericPoint Mdl.C`. The target then follows from the standard glue lemma `Inseparable.of_eq` (in `Mathlib/Topology/Inseparable.lean`) applied to the symmetric equality, giving `Inseparable (genericPoint Mdl.C) (ψ.base (genericPoint Mdl.C))`. No Mathlib declaration states inseparability of the generic point and its image directly, so this is not a verbatim duplicate; the library's own proof rewrites with the local wrapper `base_genericPoint` (itself `genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion ψ`) and closes `Inseparable x x`, so it does not literally apply the Mathlib declaration.
